voice.summary: Speaks like a good charge nurse at handover: short, unambiguous and free of drama. Status words are fixed and never softened.
dos: Use the same status words everywhere: occupied, cleaning, ready
Lead with the bed or bay number
donts: No abbreviations that are not on the ward

taglines: Know the ward, hand over well
One board for the whole bay
boilerplate: Marlowe General runs Ward 6B with a live bed board that shows each bay, each bed's status and the steps from discharge through cleaning to ready.

microcopy.error: Could not update that bed, check the connection
microcopy.empty: Select a bed to see details and actions

logo.note: A pulse line is the universal sign of a hospital without being gloomy.
